items.statement: I found one specific, dated AI-related initiative for Diadem Sports: on January 18, 2026, Diadem Pickleball Complex announced a partnership to deploy PlaySight SmartCourt technology across its Florida locations, adding AI-powered automated video capture, live streaming, performance review, highlights, and data-driven insights.

citations.title: PlaySight and Diadem Pickleball Announce Major Partnership
